links.outcome: Framework classification F1 on internal versus external TCIA CT cohorts
links.effect: Internal weighted F1 0.920-1.000, macro-F1 0.879-1.000; external weighted F1 0.946-1.000, macro-F1 0.777-0.929, so the external macro-F1 lower bound was lower.
links.quote: At the framework level, Orchestrate achieved high classification performance across internal (weighted F<sub>1</sub>-score ranged from 0.920 to 1.000; macro-F<sub>1</sub>-score ranged from 0.879 to 1.000) and external (weighted F<sub>1</sub>-score ranged from 0.946 to 1.000; macro-F<sub>1</sub>-score ranged from 0.777 to 0.929) cohorts.

unlisted_practices: Using pixel-based deep learning classification instead of DICOM metadata to label CT series
Automated routing and orchestration of imaging series to downstream AI

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI orchestration pipeline to classify CT series from pixel data rather than relying on noisy DICOM metadata, facilitating downstream clinical workflow and AI deployment.
